reason: When the ownership check fails, the new packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/deleteCache.handler.ts:18-20 throws a plain `new Error("Credential not found or access denied")`, not a TRPCError. The repo's errorFormatter (packages/trpc/server/errorFormatter.ts:25-39) only remaps ZodError causes, and no middleware converts plain errors, so tRPC returns INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (500).
